{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u020/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a59369e8.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            colors = {grid[y][x] for y, x in cells}
            components.append((len(colors), cells))
    _, cells = max(components, key=lambda item: item[0])
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
